decisions.executionNote: Begin left-arm approach to basket, gradually orienting gripper downward; board appears to specify blue race car. Keep right arm parked.
Retry with halved increments after zero-step IK rejection; form downward approach while keeping joint continuity.
Track rightward-moving basket with left arm; advance above near half while continuing gradual downward orientation.

Close around left basket rim and perform small retention lift; assess basket motion visually before raising further.
Rim was not retained: basket continued drifting and jaws appear empty. Reopen and track right/forward to straddle left wall more securely.
Clear basket rim vertically before repositioning over it; previous low approach appears to push the wall rather than straddle it. Keep left EE on left side of center.
Replan from executed one-step prefix with smaller upward increments and forward displacement to clear rim without joint jumps.
Vertical clearance approaches a kinematic limit. Tilt tool to a shallower approach while keeping position nearly fixed and tracking basket side.
Advance the tilted left gripper to basket side rim and gain modest fingertip clearance; monitor increasing reach.
Basket side appears between left jaws. Close and test retention with an upward/backward motion that reduces forward reach.
Basket not retained and has entered right workspace. Retract left arm and begin right-arm basket approach without crossing arms; left can subsequently pick target.
Retry with reduced left retreat increments after no execution; right arm begins basket approach.
Right arm advances at a shallow downward angle toward basket's right wall; left retracts to its own workspace.
Approach right basket wall above the rim at the current shallow tool angle, compensating rightward drift. Left remains clear.
Use right wrist view to center basket right-side rim between jaws, advance just past front edge, then close while matching belt motion.
Wrist view shows jaws inside basket rather than straddling wall. Reopen and shift right toward visible right side, with slight clearance, then close on rim.
Complete right gripper closure with wall within jaw span, then test retention by lifting upward and toward robot, preserving reach margin.
Test shows no basket retention. Recenter farther right so side wall lies at jaw midpoint, not merely near outer jaw; lower to engage and close.
Right wrist still shows side wall right of jaw midpoint. Reopen and shift laterally outward another small span, then close on wall.
Finish closing around now-straddled right wall, then lift and retract modestly to test retention from RGB.
Reopen and align actual wall at wrist-image jaw midpoint with a larger lateral correction; lower shallow approach to improve wall engagement. Stop short of extension limit.
Revise depth estimate: repeated empty pinches suggest rim lower and farther than estimated. Approach nearer basket wall at lower height, reducing lateral reach instead of chasing far wall.
Basket contacted and tilted at lower approach; shift onto nearer wall visible left of right wrist jaw midpoint, then close gently by position command.
Finish closure with nearer basket wall now between jaws and make a short retention lift; inspect for basket following instead of belt drift.
Basket wall now remains at closed fingertips. Lift another 10 cm while retracting toward reachable central-right space; verify retention and basket attitude.
Basket slipped/not retained. Correct excessive grasp height and approach the nearer side rim at substantially lower tool height, using observed contact geometry.
Basket has shifted forward/right; follow with right gripper open toward nearer rim. Move left above blue racecar without closing yet, preserving task order.
Reduce right tool pitch and height to regain reach margin while following nearer basket wall; left hovers over identified blue car with gripper open.
Bring right jaw midpoint onto the basket wall visible to its right, using small reach-limited increments; left tracks car without grasping.

Align right gripper to nearest basket corner rather than broad wall face, then close. Maintain left target alignment while basket grasp is tested.
Empty closure observed. Advance right fingertips toward nearest basket corner with small forward/outward increments while lowering link6 to retain kinematic margin.
Reach-limited prefix interrupted. Raise fingertip approach angle rather than extending link6 farther, bringing jaws toward basket rim with improved elbow configuration.
Approach nearest upright basket corner with horizontal jaws, adding yaw to reach around rim while retracting link6 slightly; close once corner is centered.
Change grasp strategy: roll right jaws vertically to straddle front rim from the side, rather than close horizontally against broad wall. Retract slightly while gaining rim height.
Continue vertical-jaw reorientation using reduced roll increments after one-step interruption; raise to rim level while retracting to preserve reach.
Finish vertical jaw alignment while pointing tool farther right toward departing basket rim. Lower slightly and limit translation to preserve continuous IK.

Closed jaws remain just short of nearest basket corner. Reopen, advance and lower a small amount to encompass rim, then close while following drift.
